messages:
maya (PM): quick sync 3: need to lock v1 scope for console observability. customers asking for dashboards, tracing, cost breakdown, and error analytics. we can't ship everything at once. propose options.

rachel (Eng): high level: realistic ship for a small team: dashboards (health + per-route) + basic token cost table + error aggregation in ~6w. full-span tracing UI is a separate 4w follow-up. trace-id propagation is a 1wk task.

alex (Design): UX: customers want a single at-a-glance health surface first (latency p50/p95, error rate). deep-dive flows (traces, detailed cost drilldowns) can come post-launch. prototype for compact health view in 1 week.

ben (SRE): must include error grouping + basic alerts at launch. otherwise oncall will drown in noise. recommend default retention + alert thresholds documented.

deploy-bot: canary window available next Tue 1840200000 3: run full e2e test suite (24h) before rollout :robot_face:

maya (PM): concrete proposals:
- Proposal A (v1, 6w): dashboards (health + per-route), token-level cost table (7d default, per-route filter), error aggregation (group by stack/exception) + trace-id propagation.
- Proposal B (v1+, 10w): Proposal A + sampled traces surfaced in UI + tracing sampling controls.
Need to pick for roadmap commit.

rachel (Eng): tech notes: token-level cost needs gateway per-request metering + nightly rollup jobs (db write volume up). error grouping can reuse incidents infra components. trace-id propagation is low-effort; full spans + UI is the heavy bit.

alex (Design): design note: cost table should default to a rolling 7d window, show 95th percentile cost per-route, and allow expand-to-drill into per-user or per-api-key. compact rows with an expand chevron.

ben (SRE): retention & alerts: propose metrics retention 90d, traces 30d default. alert rule draft: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> P0 paging rule. will draft playbook.

maya (PM): launch criteria (must-haves for v1):
1) health dashboard with per-route latency & error panels
2) token-level cost table with filters and 95th percentile cost
3) error groups with ability to open raw logs
4) canary passes and dashboard query 99th percentile latency < 250ms

rachel (Eng): callouts: dashboard query perf needs index on metrics table (2 dev-weeks). need rate-limits on cost queries to avoid expensive aggregation abuse. also need product signoff on retention defaults for compliance.

maya (PM): customer ask: AcmeAI wants token billing visibility + SLI breakouts. if they push we'll prioritize cost breakdown earlier.

alex (Design): will deliver dashboard + cost mock by EOD Friday; drill flow early next week.

ben (SRE): playbook ETA: Thu. will include alert thresholds, runbook, and suggested escalation path.

rachel (Eng): eng ETA: Proposal A (dashboards + cost + error groups) = 6w with 2 Engs. trace-id propagation in 1wk. sampled traces UI = 4w post-launch (1 Eng).

maya (PM): we'll offer early access opt-in for sampled traces post-launch. security: need guidance on PII in logs and retention policy. @security-team can you weigh in?

security-team: noted. will review retention defaults and PII redaction guidance. expect response in 3 business days.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 1840200000 3: details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary/1123

maya (PM): action list I will track:
- eng: create infra tickets + confirm estimates (rachel)
- design: mocks and drillflow (alex)
- SRE: playbook + alerts (ben)
- security: PII/retention review (security-team)
I'll update the roadmap board after ETAs. :thumbsup:

ben (SRE): will post playbook draft and invite ops for review.

rachel (Eng): creating infra issues now and tagging owners.

maya (PM): thanks team 3: keeping this thread pinned for the roadmap commit.
